FATEX_THEMES.PickThemeLabel: Pick the visual theme for this sheet:
FATEX_THEMES.PickThemeHint: The theme only changes the look. Mechanics, skills, aspects, and data remain identical.
FATEX_THEMES.Status.UsingGlobal: This sheet uses the world's GLOBAL theme: {theme}
FATEX_THEMES.Status.HasOverride: This sheet has an INDIVIDUAL theme set: {theme}
FATEX_THEMES.Tooltip.UsingGlobal: This sheet uses the global theme. Click to set an individual theme.
FATEX_THEMES.Tooltip.HasOverride: This sheet has an individual theme. Click to change it or revert to global.
FATEX_THEMES.Notif.ResetToGlobal: Sheet now uses the world's global theme.
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.GlobalTheme.Name: World global theme
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.GlobalTheme.Hint: Theme applied to every sheet that does NOT have an individual theme set.
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.AllowPlayer.Name: Allow players to change theme on their own sheets
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.AllowPlayer.Hint: If disabled (default), only the GM sees the theme picker button.
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.CollapseHeader.Nam: Collapse header buttons into a menu (☰)
FATEX_THEMES.Settings.CollapseHeader.Hin: Hides 'Edit Mode', 'Sheet Configuration', 'Theatre', etc. inside a dropdown menu to save space at the top of the sheet. The close button remains visible.
FATEX_INIT.Tooltip: Configure the initiative skill and bonus for this sheet
FATEX_INIT.DialogHint: Initiative will be rolled as: 4dF + skill + bonus. Works automatically with the Carousel Combat Tracker and the default tracker.
FATEX_INIT.Status.NoGlobal: No global skill set and no individual override. Initiative will use the system's default formula.
FATEX_INIT.UseGlobalOptionEmpty: Use global skill (none set — default formula)
FATEX_INIT.BonusHint: Fixed value added to the roll (can be negative). Useful for situations like surprise advantage, gear, etc.
FATEX_INIT.Notif.SkillNotFound: Initiative: skill "{skill}" not found on sheet "{actor}". Rolling with rank 0.
FATEX_INIT.Settings.GlobalSkill.Name: Global initiative skill
FATEX_INIT.Settings.GlobalSkill.Hint: Name of the skill used as default for initiative. Applies to every sheet without an individual override. Leave empty to use Foundry's default formula.
FATEX_INIT.Settings.AllowPlayer.Name: Allow players to configure initiative on their own sheets
FATEX_INIT.Settings.AllowPlayer.Hint: If disabled (default), only the GM can change skill and bonus. If enabled, players can configure their own sheets.
